mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% for the past 3 months indicates robust demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 5% for the past month signals expanding industrial production, enhancing corporate profits and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% in the next month signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and driving negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3pp in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing above 5.0% (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% in the next month indicates tightening monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 1.5% (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding 110 in the next month signals robust industrial production, boosting manufacturing activity and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 110 in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite INDPRO crossing above 110 (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS below 1.0%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%) creates conflicting signals, weakening market sentiment and predicting negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite both FEDFUNDS below 1.0% and UNRATE above 5.0% (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (evidenced by rising FEDFUNDS over the past 3 months), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increasing for the past 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive during a tightening cycle (t-test p < 0.05).
